title: Universal adversarial suffixes
organization: Carnegie Mellon University; Center for AI Safety

cells.title: Source
body: "Universal and Transferable Adversarial Attacks on Aligned Language Models" was submitted to arXiv in July 2023.
The paper described adversarial suffixes that transferred across aligned models.

cells.title: Observed behavior
body: The authors optimized strings that could be appended to user requests to increase the likelihood of policy-violating completions.
The striking part of the artifact is that the suffixes were mostly unreadable token sequences rather than persuasive natural language.

cells.title: Provenance
body: The archive does not reproduce attack strings.
